faq.q: What is the origin of Aqdas?
faq.a: Aqdas is associated with Arabic. Aqdas, elative of قدّوس ('holy'), meaning 'most holy, most sacred'.
Yes — the underlying form أقدس is Arabic.
Aqdas can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
